requirements.text: The system shall ensure compliance with applicable financial regulations and standards.
The system shall provide necessary transaction logs including date, time, type, amount, and updated balance.
The system shall ensure that no account can have a negative balance during transactions.
The system shall implement secure PIN verification for user authentication.
The system shall automatically withdraw funds from the related savings account when necessary.
The system shall notify users immediately if a transaction cannot be completed due to insufficient funds.
The system shall provide a mechanism for users to review their transaction history securely.
The ATM system shall process transactions within 3 seconds to ensure user responsiveness.
The system shall minimize energy consumption by optimizing transaction processing.
The system shall utilize energy-efficient hardware components to operate.
The system shall provide an option for clients to receive electronic transaction records instead of paper receipts.
The system shall log all transactions in a way that minimizes data storage requirements.
The system shall maintain user privacy by securely encrypting all personal and financial data.

conflict_resolutions.rationale: Both requirements aimed to prevent negative balances, leading to redundancy.
